描述_EN: the eight panels consist of four pairs, all of which are identical. the lining is pale blue woven silk. textile panels. the other a pair of ducks swimming under lotus flowers and leaves. the silk embroidery consists of satin, long and short, split and stem stitches, and chinese knot and couched work. the colours are bright and varied, green and pink predominating. one represents a small bird among flowers with a butterfly hovering above. two scenes are embroidered in coloured silk thread on the red twill ground.
描述_ZN: 八块板由四对组成，都是相同的。 衬里是淡蓝色的编织丝。 纺织物面板。 另一幅是一对鸭子在荷花和荷叶下游泳。 丝绣由缎子、长针和短针、分针和茎针以及中国结和耦合工作组成。 颜色鲜艳多样，以绿色和粉色为主。 一幅表现了一只小鸟在花丛中，一只蝴蝶在上面盘旋。 在红色斜纹地上用彩色丝线绣了两个场景。
